column1: # spec-load baseline — entry, always-tokens, conditional-tokens
# W2 raised orchestrator-run 19960 -> 20573: the retired-cadence evidence and
# the domain-match rule. Paid once per run; it removes ~28k/run of crew
# dispatch, which this instrument does not see because it counts definitions,
# not dispatches. Recording both numbers is the point.
# W3 added 9/2/3 tokens to custodian/defend/declutter: the citation path grew
# from docs/ to docs/decisions/. Nothing else in those specs moved.
# W4 CORRECTION. The W1 baseline recorded orchestrated-wave at 17702 always,
# but it had already marked looper-plan and looper-build conditional, which
# the-looper did NOT do until W4 made it so. The true W1 floor was 24410;
# post-W4 it is 17433, a real -6977. An instrument that encodes the fix it is
# meant to measure reports that fix as free, and this is the note that keeps
# the error visible instead of buried in a number that never moved.
# W6 raised orchestrator-run 20573 -> 21502 and pre-flight 2020 -> 2121: the
# fast-path route with its four guards, and nonbeliever's contract duty on
# the single-wave route. Both paid once per run; together they take a small
# ask from four serial dispatches to one.
# Follow-up wave: +241 orchestrator-run (the floor's docs-vs-false-string
# tie-break), +57 declutter-run and +4 custodian-run (two false claims
# corrected in reference bodies). All three are prose that a check now
# enforces mechanically.
# +335 orchestrator-run for the brief-authoring rule that a technical claim
# used as justification gets verified before it is written, or marked
# unverified. Priced against the +241 tie-break above: a rule of the same
# shape, carrying three cited instances, and trimmed twice before this
# number was recorded. Paid once per run; it removes a verification detour
# the executing wave was paying per dispatch.
# +252 orchestrator-run for #73's corrective-budget clarification: an
# orchestrator direct-fix now counts toward correctives_this_wave /
# corrective_waves the same as a dispatched wave, so the governor's rails
# stay meaningful against it.
# +163 orchestrated-wave for #74's real-entry-point rule: verifying a fix
# against an external library now means running the entry point a real
# caller invokes, not probing the function the fix touches. Paid once per
# wave; the failure it prevents cost a shipped-then-refused build and a
# second escalation round-trip.
# +229 always / +2038 conditional on custodian-run for the `shadow` verb:
# the fabrication shadow-test on Phase B's own proposal step. The always
# half is the routing only — the verb row, the grammar clause, the trigger
# in the description, and the log line's extra field; the procedure itself
# is conditional, loaded only when the verb is invoked, which is the whole
# reason it is a verb and not a phase. Deliberately NOT a step in the
# weekly run: a recurring arm would move the 2038 onto every cron for a
# signal that moves when the model or the Phase B wording moves, not
# weekly.
# +1075 always / +233 conditional on custodian-run for the Phase B citation
# fix. The always half is spread over three files that every custodian run
# already loads: the delegation grant and the UNRESOLVED state in
# phase-detail.md (+638), the second coverage axis in SKILL.md (+213), and
# the B line's short-coverage spellings in report-issue.md (+223). The
# conditional half is the shadow-test procedure brought into line with the
# grant, loaded only on `shadow`. This is not one mechanism's worth of
# prose and is not priced as one: it is a structural repair. The spec told
# the auditor to resolve citations by existence-plus-grep and told the
# delegated auditor it could only Read, so the delegated path could not
# perform the test it was assigned — 18 of one run's 20 proposals were
# positive-form and exactly one of the two deletions carried a search
# behind it, which is what put a number on it. NOTE: the wave brief
# stated 19/20 with a single retire; the run's own log says 20 = 11
# repoint + 3 distill + 2 merge + 2 migrate + 2 retire, and the number
# recorded here is the one the log supports. A cheaper edit could have
# flipped the tool grant in one clause; the rest of the 1075 is the
# evidence that stops it being flipped back, and the accounting axis that
# would have caught the miss without a shadow-test to go looking for it.
# +353 orchestrator-run / +172 pre-flight from 9311709: the branch-path
# -flatten guardrail and the run-state.json-validate guardrail landed in
# loop-de-looper/SKILL.md, plus a matching addition in
# looper-nonbeliever/SKILL.md. Same growth the skill-body-ceiling check
# caught on loop-de-looper's own ceiling; this is that same commit's cost
# on the other side of the accounting.
# +159 pre-flight: prettier reflowed looper-nonbeliever's table once
# 9311709's addition widened a cell, padding every row to match. No
# content changed, only column width.
